image.scope: The exact image was inspected only in the local Docker Engine. Its local RepoDigest was not resolved against a registry, and no registry reference, signature bundle, or provenance attestation was supplied. Absence of local evidence cannot prove that no signature exists in an unknown external registry.

sboms.scope: SHA-256 checksum sealing provides local file-integrity evidence only; it is not a digital signature, registry attestation, or SLSA provenance statement.
